# superset_css_template (Resource)

Manages a CSS template: a reusable stylesheet that can be applied to dashboards.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "superset_css_template" "dark_header" {
  template_name = "Dark header"
  css           = <<-EOT
    .dashboard-header {
      background-color: #1f1f1f;
      color: #ffffff;
    }
  EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `css` (String) The stylesheet.
- `template_name` (String) Name of the template as shown in Superset.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the template.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A CSS template is imported by its numeric id.
terraform import superset_css_template.dark_header 7
```
